nodes.rationale: A whole-session-lifecycle property no per-task review caught: the sidebar wipe button silently left real patient identifiers (merged_phi_map, resolved_field_values, header_values, and dynamically-keyed hdr_* widgets) in memory for the clinical-form path.

nodes.label: Bug: stale re-identified export race after refine/regenerate
nodes.rationale: Code was modeled on the free-form draft dict and reset a dead 'reidentified' key instead of invalidating 'resolved_field_values' — the key the download button actually reads — so a practitioner could review revision N and download revision N-1.

nodes.label: Section-path field key slug scheme
nodes.rationale: Keys combine the current section/subsection path with the row label so a label repeated under two sections (e.g. 'Mood' under both 'Current functioning' and 'Mood and affect') gets distinct keys instead of colliding.

nodes.label: 'Nothing touches disk' in-memory fill pattern
nodes.rationale: Templates are bundled read-only assets; every fill happens on an in-memory python-docx Document re-saved to BytesIO, matching the existing pattern already used elsewhere in the app rather than writing a working copy to a temp file.

nodes.label: Existing _as_docx() nothing-touches-disk precedent
